value.description: The predicted monthly amount for this counterparty, regardless of how many transactions in minor units of the currency, eg. pennies for GBP.

monthlyAverageOnly.description: A flag indicating whether the predictions are based only on a monthly average or not. If the predictions are based solely on monthly averages then the dates array will be defaulted to the end of the month for the next 3 motnhs.
